description:
## Goal
Delete the `DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE` constant alias from `src/vug/fetcher.cr`. The canonical value is `Vug::GrayPlaceholderHandler::DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE` and the alias has no users.

## Why (DRY + dead code)
The constant is declared with the comment:

> Backward-compatible alias — canonical value lives in GrayPlaceholderHandler.

A repo-wide search confirms `Fetcher::DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE` (and `Vug::Fetcher::DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE`) is not referenced anywhere — not in `src/`, not in `spec/`, not in any documentation. The "backward-compatible" purpose has no consumer, so the alias is dead code that:
- Re-implements the indirection the comment warns against (one more place to keep in sync).
- Adds noise to `fetcher.cr`'s top-level surface.
- Misleads readers into thinking the value can be overridden via `Fetcher::DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE`.

## Approach
1. Delete lines 31-33 of `src/vug/fetcher.cr`:
   ```crystal
   # Backward-compatible alias — canonical value lives in GrayPlaceholderHandler.
   DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE = GrayPlaceholderHandler::DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE
   ```
2. If `GrayPlaceholderHandler` was only `require`d to satisfy this alias, keep the require (it is also used by `@gray_placeholder_handler`).

## Acceptance
- `Fetcher::DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE` no longer exists.
- The canonical `Vug::GrayPlaceholderHandler::DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE` is unchanged.
- A repo-wide grep for `Fetcher::DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE` returns no matches.
- All specs pass.
- `ameba` is clean.

## Notes
- This is the smallest, safest ticket in the epic. Good first PR.
title: Remove dead Fetcher::DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE alias
